# Abyss Audio 1.0.0
- First public release of Abyss Audio for macOS. - Control Mac output, input, and the volume of individual applications. - Mix longer audio in Abyss Deck with seeking, looping, speed, and EQ controls. - Play short soundboard clips through speakers or a configured virtual microphone. - Record audio, monitor your microphone, and shape your voice in real time. - Added a compact menu-bar controller and four colour themes. - Added private, signed updates with a short changelog before installation.
